avd-current-state

Inventory and validate. Read-only PowerShell that answers what is in an AVD environment today, whether a subscription is ready for a deployment, and whether the deployment landed correctly.

The repo is the source of truth: nickprignano/avd-current-state. This page says where it fits.

What it does

  • The collector builds a portable evidence package of the AVD workload and the platform around it.
  • The validator runs preflight and post-deployment checks and writes a pass/fail report.
  • Only Get- and Test- calls against Azure. Nothing is created, changed or deleted.
  • The facts script turns packages into one redacted snapshot (contract C11): counts, public values and pseudonyms, no names or IDs.

How it fits

  • Its C11 facts feed avd-second-brain; avd-swarm sees them only as cited evidence from the brain.
  • The validator checks a avd-landing-zone deployment before and after.
